data.title: About Cristina
bio: Born and raised on Staten Island, NY I moved to New Jersey back in 2013 right before I got married to my husband, Jon.  We have three kiddos, Logan, Layla, and Lainey--all just a year apart from one another.  In our free time we love cooking with our team in the competition BBQ circuit!  After teaching for almost two decades I decided it was time for a change.

I earned my real estate license during covid and have been a licensed Realtor since 2021.  I absolutely love making those interpersonal connections, much like I did while I was a teacher, and helping people find their perfect home!  Two decades in the filed of education really allow me evaluate data, situations, and get a quick gauge of how a client is feeling.  Being able to pivot on a dime and adjust to any scenario is a quality I find invaluable as a real estate agent.
I absolutely love refurbishing furniture pieces.  My husband and I are an award winning BBQ team.  My original background is in broadcast journalism and writing.
